title: Sub-agents
description:
currently when calling @completionTools there's one huge prompt for an agent to go off and call tools.
The way that Cursor and other competitors use their agents, is they try to chop up a task into small, digestible pieces, and send each of these small task to a precise sub-agent.
The main benefit is that these sub-agents work on something small, require a much simpler prompt, will end up having a much smaller context window and need to be exposed to a smaller set of tools.
We already had setup this project to have the Planner, Contexter, Tester and Developer agents via @agentRunnerTools - but they are not being used as described above to accomplish a task from even a single chat message.

This story is first research and then leading to a proper plan and finally implementation of a new sub-agent architecture and tools that enable it.
